Name: Em's Desert Trader
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new tent for the desert trader and a kinder outside for their camel
Including four colour options for map recolours
Available for Content Patcher, compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7YpNqT2b/Map-Colors.png[/img]

Config options to match map recolours included:
Vanilla Stardew Valley
DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour
Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn
Starblue Valley

To choose a different sand colour:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Desert Trader mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Vanilla[/color]" with the name of the map recolour you have installed
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Desert Trader CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

Note that if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39616]Em's Large Critters[/url] installed, disable the "Desert Trader Camel"
They will be removed from the critter mod file in a planned update soon
